title: Exclude development-only original source files from app workspace
decision: Archivist should retain canonical EPP documents, CFR documents, Survey Guidance documents, and regulatory source data used by app views. Original office/catalog source files under workspaces/epp-full/source-files are development-only references for manual content work and should not be retained as app workspace content.
context: The full EPP import previously treated original catalog source files as part of the retained workspace. The user clarified that workspaces/epp-full/source-files is not needed for the app, while workspaces/epp-full/sources/regulatory is retained because those regulatory sources are pulled into and displayed or used by the app.
rationale: Keeping app workspace content focused on canonical Markdown documents and retained regulatory sources reduces noise, storage, and accidental exposure of development-only source material while preserving the regulatory data needed for CFR and Survey Guidance browsing.
alternatives_considered: Retain every original catalog source file in the app workspace
Remove all source material, including regulatory sources
Expose original source files through the app as attachments
consequences: REQ-0022 is narrowed to app-facing canonical documents, project metadata, extracted context, retained regulatory sources, and audit ledger data
SG-0007 must update the import/refresh path so source-files is physically absent from refreshed app workspaces
SG-0013 should not expose source-files in navigation, metadata controls, downloads, or document views
Regulatory sources under sources/regulatory remain retained app inputs
